title: Quickstart — ten recipes from install to a live digital twin
description: Ten self-contained scripts that answer what a new user asks first: what is installed, how to solve and compare methods, how to decide whether a field can be trusted (trust card), how to describe your own problem and generate training data, how to recover an unknown parameter from measurements, how to predict with and export a trained model, how to benchmark architectures, how much to trust a prediction, how to run a ready-made industrial case, and how to wrap a model as a digital twin. Every script prints the numbers quoted in GETTING_STARTED.md.
